   URL: https://github.com/compound-developers/compound-3-developer-faq
   const provid...ompound-v3-contracts-tutorial
   Because USDC is the most popular asset to borrow and lend, we will use USDC as the base asset in our running examples. The smart contract that handles the core logic of lending and borrowing is referred to as Comet in their literature and codebase. Compound has instances on Ethereum mainnet and on various L2s: Polygon, Base, and Arbitrum at this time of writing.
